page_title: NOT 2-3 CHE | Nottingham Forest v Chelsea 11/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+8' A cross into the box from Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) is cleared.
90+7' Djordje Petrovic leaps to intercept the corner kick from Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham).

90+7' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes out of play. Nottingham are awarded a corner kick.
90+2' Tony Harrington shows a yellow card to Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) for a tough tackle.

90+2' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) picks up the rebound inside the penalty area and releases a good shot to the right side of the goal. Unfortunately for him, Matz Sels shows how quick his reflexes are and dives superbly to stop his effort. What a save but what a wasted opportunity!
90+1' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
90' Tony Harrington couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Ola Aina (Nottingham) and blew his whistle.
88' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
87' Nuno Espirito Santo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) replacing Moussa Niakhate.
86' We are about to witness a subsitution. Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) for Callum Hudson-Odoi.
82' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) infringed the rules and goes into the book. Tony Harrington pulls out a yellow card.

82' 2 - 3 Reece James produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) rises high to head the ball into the middle of the goal and beyond the goalkeeper. He makes it 2:3.

80' 2 - 2 Goal! Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom right corner. Matz Sels had no chance of reaching it. The score is 2:2.
79' Substitution. Conor Gallagher will be replaced by Reece James (Chelsea).
77' Tony Harrington has issued a yellow card to Moussa Niakhate (Nottingham).
74' 2 - 1 Goal! Morgan Gibbs-White slips it to Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) on the edge of the box and he finds the bottom right corner with a great effort. The score is 2:1.
74' A precise low pass is received by Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
73' Substitution. Mykhailo Mudryk makes way for Raheem Sterling (Chelsea).
73' Nottingham fail to score from a corner as Djordje Petrovic (Chelsea) leaps to collect the ball.
72' Nuno Espirito Santo prepares a substitution. Ryan Yates is replaced by Harry Toffolo (Nottingham).
72' The referee signals a substitution. Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) is brought on as a substitute for Gonzalo Montiel.
71' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) gets a shot from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the crossbar!
70' The resulting corner from Cole Palmer (Chelsea) is cleared by the defence.

70' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) meets a cross inside the box, but Matz Sels wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone. The ball goes behind for a corner. Chelsea will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

69' What a chance that is! Ola Aina (Nottingham) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.
69' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) works the corner short.
68' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Chelsea.
68' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
67' The defensive wall stood firm and easily blocked the powerfully hit free kick from Cole Palmer (Chelsea) on the edge of the box.
66' Danilo (Nottingham) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Tony Harrington saw the whole situation. A free kick to Chelsea.
65' Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Tony Harrington blows for a foul.

63' Thiago Silva (Chelsea) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross from the resulting free kick and attempts to score with a header from near the penalty spot. His effort lacks accuracy and bounces away off the left post.
62' Tony Harrington blows his whistle. Moussa Niakhate (Nottingham) commits a foul after dangerous play.
62' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
61' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
61' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
59' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) makes a rough challenge and Tony Harrington blows his whistle for a foul.
58' Substitution. Benoit Badiashile leaves the pitch and is replaced by Malo Gusto (Chelsea).
58' Mauricio Pochettino has decided to make a change. Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) replaces Noni Madueke.
58' Great chance! Chris Wood (Nottingham) picks up a rebound inside the box, cuts inside his marker but rifles his shot high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.
57' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header only flies onto the right post and away off it!
56' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) takes a wild swing at a rebound from mid-range and it goes well wide of the right post.
54' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) makes a strong challenge and Tony Harrington blows for a foul.

53' What a chance that is! Ryan Yates (Nottingham) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass on the edge of the box and fires towards the net. Unfortunately for him, he only hits the right post! The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.

50' Wasted opportunity! Ola Aina (Nottingham) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Chelsea.
49' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
49' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Tony Harrington blows for a foul.
47' Noni Madueke received a sweet pass from Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea), but the advance is stopped.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+5' The percentage of ball possession is – 28:72.
45+2' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Chris Wood (Nottingham) heads on.

45+1' Chris Wood (Nottingham) blew a promising chance when he got to a rebound just outside the penalty area. He struck it towards the middle of the target, but Djordje Petrovic pulled off a nice save to stop the attempt.
45+1' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' The corner kick from Cole Palmer (Chelsea) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
40' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
39' Benoit Badiashile (Chelsea) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders. Chelsea force their opponents to concede a corner.
39' The free kick is taken by Conor Gallagher (Chelsea), but ball is cleared.
39' It looks like Danilo (Nottingham) saw red with that tackle. Tony Harrington won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Chelsea are awarded a free kick.
38' Chelsea are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
36' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
34' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) was quite harsh and Tony Harrington didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
34' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

34' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and Matz Sels easily makes the save. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea have been awarded a corner kick.
32' The corner from Cole Palmer (Chelsea) is cleared away by the defence.
32' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Noni Madueke (Chelsea). The ball goes out of play. Chelsea are awarded a corner kick.
30' The game is interrupted now, Ryan Yates (Nottingham) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
29' Chelsea control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
27' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) was too forceful with his tackle and Tony Harrington interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
23' Chris Wood (Nottingham) is furious with himself. He pounced on a rebound and from close range directed a header narrowly over the bar! The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.
23' Corner kick. Danilo (Nottingham) is ready to send the ball into the box.
22' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. Nottingham will take a corner kick.
19' The linesman raises his flag. Chris Wood (Nottingham) is adjudged offside.
18' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Nottingham players have a reason to celebrate!
17' The Nottingham players halt their celebrations as referee Tony Harrington makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

16' 1 - 1 Perfectly taken free kick! Morgan Gibbs-White sends a cross in and Willy Boly (Nottingham) leaps high to connect with it on the edge of the 6-yard box. His close-range header goes inside the right post and he makes it 1:1.
15' Benoit Badiashile (Chelsea) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
15' Chelsea failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
13' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Chelsea.
12' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.

10' The ball rebounds out to Ryan Yates (Nottingham) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Chelsea.
10' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
8' 0 - 1 Goal! Cole Palmer shows great vision to find Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
7' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) produces a header from long distance, but his naive attempt ends way wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.
5' Danilo (Nottingham) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
5' Gonzalo Montiel (Nottingham) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. Nottingham win a corner.
4' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
2' Chris Wood (Nottingham) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it under the roof. Unfortunately for him, Djordje Petrovic makes a great save to stop his effort.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Chelsea will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Tony Harrington.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
